title: Juniper and the Postcard
author: Rosalind Hartwell
blurb: Yara Underhill, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, has spent twelve years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the bakery lease runs out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
